title: Unadmitted receipt check: compare observed-check summaries in the order sent
outcome: validate_unadmitted (src/engram_unadmitted_observation.rs) sorts the sent and recorded check ids before comparing them, so a reordered receipt passes. Engram builds the summaries in the order the host sent them (storage/unadmitted_observation.rs:83-91). The check compares them in order, and its test refuses a reordered receipt.
acceptance: A receipt naming the request's checks in the sent order is accepted and one naming them reordered is refused; unit tests show both.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
